snippet.title: Barbotine Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Out now on Steam and Itch.io, Barbotine is an atmospheric horror game that touches on topics of anxiety, isolation, body image and obsessive habits with a surreal PSX aesthetic. 

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2845840/Barbotine/
Play for free or donate on Itch.io: https://alex-rassloff.itch.io/barbotine
